provenance.note: REVERT of 3 llm-authored combat rules: A/B on v5 (100 eps each, parallel runner) showed mean score 217.0 WITH rules vs 396.4 WITHOUT (median depth 2 vs 3). Rules engraved Elbereth while adjacent at <=40% HP and forced ranged_then_kill against everything — wrong response tier for DL1-3 melee deaths. Superseded by interlock-only rule set.
provenance.reason: Starvation deaths at depth 1 are persisting despite previous radius increases, with episodes lasting ~8000 turns. The agent is stuck in explore_floor without transitioning to foraging or praying. Reducing the prayer routine interval significantly to trigger emergency food recovery more frequently and lowering the routine prayer first-threshold to ensure the agent seeks divine sustenance before the hunger state becomes critical.
